create_rotation_matrix: create a 4x4 rotation matrix from an angle, direction vector, and optional pivot point
convert_euler_angles_to_matrix: build a 4x4 homogeneous rotation matrix from Euler roll, pitch, yaw angles with a specified axis sequence
convert_quaternion_to_matrix: create a 4x4 homogeneous rotation matrix from a quaternion represented as [x, y, z, w]
decompose_transformation_matrix: decompose a 4x4 transformation matrix into scale, shear, Euler angles, translation, and perspective components
compute_superimposition_matrix: compute the optimal rotation, translation, and scaling matrix to superimpose one set of 3D vectors onto another
